title: gendefine Mapping Configuration
description: Schema for JSON mapping configurations that map metadata spreadsheet formats to Define-XML v2.1 concepts.

mapping_version.description: Version of this mapping configuration format.

description.description: Description of the spreadsheet format this mapping supports.

worksheets.description: Mapping definitions keyed by worksheet name.

oid_patterns.description: OID generation patterns keyed by Define-XML element type.

value_transforms.description: Value transform definitions keyed by transform name.

defaults.description: Default values for Define-XML attributes keyed by attribute name.

global_settings.description: Global settings that apply across all worksheets.

language.description: Default xml:lang value for TranslatedText elements.

default_purpose.description: Default Purpose value for ItemGroupDef when not in spreadsheet.

annotated_crf_leaf_id.description: Leaf ID for the annotated CRF document reference.

oid_generation_strategy.description: Default OID strategy: 'pattern' generates from templates, 'column' reads from spreadsheet.

worksheet_entry.description: Mapping definition for a single worksheet.

format.description: Worksheet layout: 'attribute_value' for key-value pairs, 'tabular' for header + data rows.

column_map.description: Column-to-attribute mappings keyed by spreadsheet column name.

oid_pattern.description: OID generation pattern for this worksheet's target element (e.g., 'IG.{Dataset}').

oid_source.description: Column name that provides OIDs when strategy is 'column'.

column_map_entry.description: Mapping definition for a single spreadsheet column.

also.description: Additional attributes to populate with the same value.

oid_role.description: Role in OID generation: 'component' contributes to OID, 'parent_lookup' references parent element.

oid_source.description: Indicates this column provides explicit OID values.

oid_prefix.description: Prefix for OIDs generated from this column's values.

optional.description: Whether this column can contain empty/null values.

type.description: Type coercion target for this column's values.

processing.description: Name of a value_transform to apply to this column's values.

ignore_for_define.description: If true, this column is read but excluded from Define-XML generation.

map.description: Lookup table mapping input values to output values (for 'lookup' type).

default.description: Default value when lookup has no match (for 'lookup' type).

output_fields.description: Output field names for regex capture groups (for 'regex_parse' type).
